name: NL-DIR
description: NL-DIR is a benchmark for natural language-based document image retrieval, where fine-grained semantic textual queries are used to retrieve document images. The dataset contains 41K document images each paired with five high-quality natural language queries.
reputation: A niche but credible retrieval benchmark from the document understanding community, mainly used in recent research on text-to-document-image retrieval.
notes: Includes natural language queries generated and verified by LLMs and humans; supports evaluation of vision-language and OCR-free models.
